quote.text: There is no shame in making an honest effort.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the journey of parenthood by consistently putting forth your best effort, knowing that genuine care and perseverance will guide your children better than an unattainable ideal of perfection.
    • Understand that mistakes are part of growth—for both you and your child—and that honest efforts, even when imperfect, build trust, resilience, and a legacy of integrity.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, lead by example; demonstrate that commitment to a sincere effort fosters respect, even if challenges or failures occur along the way.
    • Recognize that true leadership is defined not by flawless outcomes but by the integrity and perseverance shown in addressing obstacles and learning from them.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, focus on making honest, diligent efforts to iterate and improve, understanding that each step—regardless of the outcome—contributes valuable lessons to your growth.
    • Keep in mind that transparent and consistent dedication to enhancing the product builds a culture of trust and continuous learning, encouraging both innovation and accountability.
